_about: The key set of the apps' texts, in the order and groups they are written to strings.xml (Android) and Localizable.xcstrings (iOS). The text of each key lives in strings/<lang>.json; da.json is the source, en.json the fallback language. Placeholders are positional Android style (%1$s string, %2$d integer, %% a percent sign) in every language; the iOS generator maps them to %1$@ / %1$lld. Edit with scripts/i18n/build.mjs --check in the loop.
